bio.text: Lena Gonzalez, a Democrat, represents the 33rd Senate District in the California State Senate and is Senate Majority Leader.
Her official website says she previously served on the Long Beach City Council and worked at Microsoft.
According to the same page, she holds a BA in political science from Cal State Long Beach and an Executive MBA from Loyola Marymount University, and lives in Long Beach.
